result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I didn't run any tests or compile, since it's a one-token change.

The block was formatting `loc180Days` for the LOC figure and `loc90Days` for the percentage. I changed the LOC figure to `loc90Days`, so the figure and the percentage now use the same value. The fix is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.addBigRepositoriesSummary`, in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`.
